svg.title: 剧本创作流程时序图
svg.desc: 根据虚拟世界项目当前代码绘制，包含主智能体、按需委派的团队子智能体、作品读取、提案审批、本地保存与人物状态接续。

text.tspan: 剧本团队创作流程｜一名主智能体统筹，按任务调用已启用的团队成员

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 推荐建设顺序，可按用户任务从中间开始

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 人物与制作约束 → 全剧主线 → 已配置的剧情阶段 → 分集／分场目录 → 剧本与人物状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 作品全文供工具按需读取；目录和规则不能代替实际内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 下一次任务会重新准备当时的作品内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [任务需要已关联的技能或素材]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 团队成员按需调用，每次调用创建新的子智能体

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 子智能体不能继续召唤子智能体；它的修改也要经过审批和保存

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [团队模式中，主智能体判断需要某位成员协助]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 剧本正文须能拍摄或排演：场景标题写清内外景、地点、时间

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 动作以△开头；对白标角色；OS／VO及闪回、梦境按格式标记

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [写入人物、剧情、正文中的其它阶段，且未开启自动允许]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 当前剧集／段落正文保存到 body；结束时的人物状态保存到 character_state

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 记录处境、关系、情绪、知情范围、道具、未解冲突和下一段接续点

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [按任务反复读取、调用模型、写作；需要时委派团队成员]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 主智能体和子智能体的提案共用此流程；审批与保存可在智能体执行期间进行

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

text.tspan: 接着写下一集／下一场时：读取相关人物、剧情、相邻剧本及上一段人物状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 剧本以剧集／段落及其人物状态接续故事；当前流程没有长篇的卷、章卡和连续性账本提交步骤

font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 创建或打开剧本创作空间

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 创建或读取作品

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 读写作品索引、人物、剧情和正文文件

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回作品结构与已有内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 说明目标，选择当前阶段或剧集／段落

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 读取本书写作规则 AGENTS.md

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 读取规则文件

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回本书规则

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 准备发送时的作品内容与版本

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 包括人物、剧情、各段剧本和人物状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 发送目标、目录、当前焦点、规则

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 提供模型、审批设置与可用团队成员

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 结合目标与规则规划本轮任务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 选择要读的条目与要做的操作

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: read：完整读取相关人物与剧情

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 写剧本时读取相邻剧本、上一段人物状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回本轮作品内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 也可看到本轮已经提出的修改

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 加入读到的内容，继续推理与写作

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: load_skill / query_linked_material_entries

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回写作方法或参考素材

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 加入本次需要的方法与参考

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: spawn_subagent：交给已启用成员一个明确任务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 主智能体等待此次调用结束

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 使用自身提示词与分派任务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 模型可继承主智能体，也可单独配置

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 按任务独立 read 所需内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回同一本作品的本轮内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 加入读取结果，完成子任务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回分析成果或候选修改

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: create / edit：提出修改

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 跨阶段操作先按设置取得允许

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 显示子智能体提案

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 走下方相同的审批与保存流程

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回最终交接摘要，主智能体继续

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 结合已读内容与团队成果，完成当前任务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 生成人物、分集／分场设计或可拍摄的剧本

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 根据写作任务，提出本段结束时的人物状态更新

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: create / edit：提交新建或修改请求

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 请求允许本次跨阶段操作

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 展示目标与影响

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 允许本次操作或取消

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 继续生成提案，或取消此次操作

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 操作获允许后生成修改提案

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 此时尚未写入本地文件

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 展示新建内容或修改差异

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 接受或拒绝；拒绝则不写文件

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 将提案排入保存队列

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 应用提案，并检查当前版本

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 防止覆盖用户后来保存的修改

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 写入人物、剧情或正文、人物状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 同时更新相关作品索引

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回保存结果，刷新作品内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回冲突或错误，保留已有内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 需重新读取后处理

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 回复任务结果，区分待审提案与已保存内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 查看、调整和继续下一集／下一场

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
